SENATE BILL 970 
C7   6lr3635 
SB 708/25 – B&T   CF 6lr3716 
By: Senator Zucker 
Introduced and read first time: February 13, 2026 
Assigned to: Rules 
 
A BILL ENTITLED 
 
AN ACT concerning 1 
 
Sports Wagering – Independent Evaluation of Sports Wagering 2 
 
FOR the purpose of requiring, rather than authorizing, certain sports wagering licensees 3 
and sports wagering operators that advertise in the State to contract with certain 4 
independent evaluators for certain purposes; and generally relating to the evaluation 5 
of sports wagering content. 6 
 
BY repealing and reenacting, with amendments, 7 
 Article – State Government 8 
Section 9–1E–17(d) 9 
 Annotated Code of Maryland 10 
 (2021 Replacement Volume and 2025 Supplement) 11 
 
 SECTION 1. BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF MARYLAND, 12 
That the Laws of Maryland read as follows: 13 
 
Article – State Government 14 
 
9–1E–17. 15 
 
 (d) A sports wagering licensee or sports wagering operator that advertises in the 16 
State [may] SHALL contract with an independent evaluator licensed under subsection (b) 17 
of this section to evaluate and rate the sports wagering licensee’s sports wagering content, 18 
sports wagering experts, sports wagering influencers, and content partners. 19 
 
 SECTION 2. AND BE IT FURTHER ENACTED, That this Act is contingent on the 20 
State Lottery and Gaming Control Commission issuing licenses as required under §  21 
9–1E–17 of the State Government Article to at least three independent evaluators. 22 
 
2 SENATE BILL 970  
 
 
 SECTION 3. AND BE IT FURTHER ENACTED, That , subject to Section 2 of  this 1 
Act, this Act shall take effect July 1, 2026. 2
